sub_theme: New Year, New Learning: Number Recap

lessons.title: Sharing Holiday News
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to talk about a holiday experience using full sentences.
success_criteria: I can share something I did over the holidays.
I can listen to a partner's news.
lessons.starter_activity: Adult shares a simple holiday story.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model sharing holiday news in full sentences.
lessons.independent_task: Children share holiday news with a partner, then feed back one fact to the class.
key_questions: What did you do in the holidays?
What did your partner tell you?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sentence complexity after the break — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Share interesting holiday news as a class.
lessons.home_link: Look at a holiday photo together and talk about it.

lessons.title: Number Recap: Counting to 30
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count, read and write numbers to 30.
success_criteria: I can read and write numbers to 30.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting to 20 from the autumn term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Extend counting to 30, modelling reading/writing new numbers (21-30).
lessons.independent_task: Children practise counting, reading, and writing numbers to 30.
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap for the new term — evidence for MATHS.N1.

lessons.title: Setting a New Year Goal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a sentence about a goal for the new term.
success_criteria: I can think of a goal.
I can write a sentence about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss the idea of a 'new year goal' simply.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a sentence about a simple goal (e.g. 'I want to read more books.').
lessons.independent_task: Children write a sentence about their own goal for the term.
key_questions: What would you like to get better at?
Can you write a sentence about it?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write 2+ sentences explaining how they'll achieve it

lessons.assessment_notes: Note goal-setting language and writing — evidence for ENG.W2/PSHE links.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your new goal with family and how they can help.

lessons.title: Addition and Subtraction Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate addition and subtraction skills built last term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition/subtraction strategies from last term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap covering addition, subtraction, and missing numbers.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed addition/subtraction recap activity, informing spring term grouping.
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap for the spring term — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Practise your favourite number sentence type.

lessons.title: Phonics: New Term Baseline
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read a range of words to establish spring term groups.
success_criteria: I can blend and read words.
I can read a short sentence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all graphemes covered so far.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Baseline consolidation session covering graphemes taught this year.
lessons.independent_task: Children read a range of word and sentence cards, with fluency noted for regrouping.
key_questions: Can you read this sentence fluently?
lessons.assessment_notes: Spring term phonics baseline for each child — evidence for ENG.R1.

lessons.title: Shape and Measure Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate shape and measurement skills built last term.
success_criteria: I can measure using a ruler.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap covering shapes and measuring.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed shape/measurement recap activity.
key_questions: How long is this in cm?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap for the spring term — evidence for MATHS.GEO/MEA.
lessons.home_link: Find shapes and measure objects at home.

lessons.title: New Term Handwriting and Spelling Check
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate spelling and handwriting progress made last term.
success_criteria: I can spell common exception words.
I can form my letters correctly.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap common exception words learned last term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap of spelling and handwriting practice.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a spelling and handwriting check activity.

differentiation.greater_depth: Write independently with joined letters if appropriate

lessons.assessment_notes: Spring term spelling/handwriting baseline — evidence for ENG.W1.
lessons.home_link: Practise your handwriting and spellings this week.

lessons.title: Fractions and Multiplication/Division Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate understanding of halves, quarters, and basic grouping/sharing.
success_criteria: I can find half and a quarter.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap of fractions and grouping/sharing.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed fractions/grouping recap activity.
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap for the spring term — evidence for MATHS.N3/N4.
lessons.home_link: Practise finding halves and quarters at home.

lessons.title: Looking Forward to Spring Term
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express what they are looking forward to this term.
success_criteria: I can say something I'm looking forward to.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's new term learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss upcoming spring term topics (oceans, explorers, animals).
lessons.independent_task: Children share one thing they are looking forward to this term.
key_questions: What are you looking forward to this term?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note positive anticipation and reflective language — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Class display reveal of things to look forward to.
lessons.home_link: Share what you're looking forward to this term with family.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Spring Term Baseline Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their current level across key number and shape skills.
success_criteria: I can count, add, subtract, and use shape/measure knowledge confidently.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Final baseline recap combining all areas covered this week.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through stations reviewing counting, number bonds, shape, and measure, allowing the teacher to note baseline levels for the spring term.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record spring term baseline levels for each child against all MATHS objectives.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising number skills over the weekend.
